markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (90%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model and all 5 neighbors agree. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 90%, Invasive 9% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | InSitu only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 94th percentile | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 InSitu | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored high; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 2, 6) · ↓ invasive · Fits in situ pattern; spot check 12/20 · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Invasive-leaning; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Nuclear size** (regions 3, 4, 5) · context · Mean 48 µm², lowest in reference set [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test +0.54 logit vs random (CI 0.47–0.60) excludes 0: faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion test +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on Unreliable normal lobules and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 4 alone scores 71% invasive risk, versus 9% for the whole image.
- Cell measurements cover only regions 3–5.

## Check on the slide
1. **4**: Region risk 71%; look for stromal invasion beyond duct borders.
2. **0, 1, 5**: Necrosis concept peaks here but is Unreliable; confirm true necrosis.
3. **3, 7, 11**: Confirm benign stroma; the normal-lobule concept was unreliable.
